judgments.reason: The vignette explicitly states 'Positive viral capsid antigen (VCA) IgM' in the serology section. VCA IgM positivity indicates acute/primary EBV infection, directly supporting the 'Acute EBV' component of the diagnosis.

The vignette explicitly states 'Positive EBV DNA in CSF' in the serology section. Detection of EBV DNA in CSF confirms EBV as the etiology of the CNS infection, supporting both the 'EBV' and 'Meningoencephalitis' components of the diagnosis.
